_about: The 17 workflows as the site's Settings → Sourcing → Workers tab shows them (owner, 24 Oct 2026). tests/test_workers_registry.py fails when a workflow's name, schedule or timeout differs from this file; the site's copy is plugins/aw-sourcing/includes/workers.php (AW_WORKERS), changed by hand together with this file. interval_min: the longest gap between two scheduled runs (late = no report for twice that). runnow: inputs sent by Run now (none: the workflow's own defaults).

sourcing.yml.name: Sourcing workers
sourcing.yml.what: Finds News, Library and press items (Google News, feeds), checks relevance, summarises with AI and sends them to the site

summary-rewrite.yml.name: Summaries: rewrite those that break the current rules
summary-rewrite.yml.what: Rewrites summaries that break Settings → Sourcing → Summary rules; starts its next run while items remain

sources-sync.yml.name: Sources sync
sources-sync.yml.what: Copies the site's source lists into sources.yaml (the workers' fallback) when Workers use these lists is on

tests.yml.name: Tests
tests.yml.what: Runs the workers' tests on every push and after Sources sync; a failure opens an issue (sourcing is not blocked)

focus-keywords.yml.name: Focus keywords (Rank Math)
focus-keywords.yml.what: Gives items without a Rank Math focus keyword one (AI, or the best words of the SEO title)

backup-offsite.yml.name: Site backup copy
backup-offsite.yml.what: Copies the site's daily database and code backup to a private GitHub release (kept 14 days)

seo-scores.yml.name: SEO scores (Rank Math)
seo-scores.yml.what: Works out Rank Math SEO scores with Rank Math's own analyser for items that have a keyword but no score

directory-enrichment.yml.name: Directory enrichment
directory-enrichment.yml.what: Finds missing contact details for Directory listings (Google Places free quota, OSM, Wikidata, websites) for review

research.yml.name: Research (India, Europe PMC and Crossref)
research.yml.what: Finds new Indian animal-welfare papers (Europe PMC, Crossref) for the Library

wp-cron.yml.name: WordPress cron
wp-cron.yml.what: Backup trigger for the site's scheduled tasks (Hostinger's server cron is the main one)

keepalive.yml.name: Keepalive
keepalive.yml.what: Switches scheduled workflows back on and commits when the repository has been quiet for 50 days

backfill.yml.name: Backfill (News + Library from 1 Nov 2025)
backfill.yml.what: One-off: older News and Library items, sent as drafts

submit.yml.name: Submit URLs (News found by hand)
submit.yml.what: Sends News URLs found by hand through the same checks and summary as sourcing

press-gnews.yml.name: Press search (one-off, Google News and Google Search)
press-gnews.yml.what: One-off: press coverage of Animal Writes through Google Search

relevance-existing.yml.name: Relevance check of existing items
relevance-existing.yml.what: One-off: checks published items against the relevance rules and stores a verdict

news-title-case.yml.name: News and press titles: sentence case (dry run)
news-title-case.yml.what: Dry run: a CSV of titles in sentence case; writes nothing to the site

same-story-fold.yml.name: Same story: fold duplicates into the first story
same-story-fold.yml.what: Folds a duplicate story into the first one (pairs given by hand)
